source: faça um jogo com tudo em 3D de um jogo de simulador de urso na floresta gigante com um mapa grande com botões joystick correr pular bater e a câmera em terceira pessoa com o modelo do meu urso que eu vou estar controlando ultra realista coloca sistema de dia e noite e coloca vários tipos de árvore e tipo Matos arbustos e coloca rios grande no jogo

image_prompt.text: Natural shelters such as caves and hollows in the forest that the bear claims and returns to
A distinct forest landmark visible across the map so the bear can navigate by sight
A central oversized forest clearing built to hold many animals at once without crowding
A giant forest covering a large map, planted with many different types of trees
Bushes and low scrub undergrowth spread between the trees
Large rivers running through the forest

notes: The prompt asks for a day and night cycle and an ultra-realistic look; neither is a layout option, so both are carried for the lighting and material steps.
Preset Animal Sim contributed den-shelter, landmark-focal and social-hub; the prompt names none of the three.

open_questions.ask: How big is the giant map meant to be - a few hundred studs of forest, or a full open world over 2000 studs?
What does the bear actually do - hunt, survive, or roam and roleplay with other bears?
Should the whole forest be photorealistic, or only the bear model?

coverage_missing.ask: What does the bear actually do - hunt, survive, or roam and roleplay with other bears?

answers.ask: How big is the giant map meant to be - a few hundred studs of forest, or a full open world over 2000 studs?
answers.answer: Quero um mapa grande de floresta com mais de 2000 studs, como um mundo aberto para o urso explorar.

answers.ask: What does the bear actually do - hunt, survive, or roam and roleplay with other bears?
answers.answer: O foco é sobreviver na floresta, com o urso explorando o mapa e usando correr, pular e bater.

answers.ask: Should the whole forest be photorealistic, or only the bear model?
answers.answer: Quero tudo com visual ultra-realista: o urso, a floresta, as árvores, matos, arbustos, rios e iluminação de dia e noite.
